songs.title: NOAH
songs.verdict: A 20-track rap concept album retelling Noah's Ark from Noah's side, built on murky, eerie production that rewards anyone who likes their boom-bap dense and strange.
songs.body:
Teller Bank$ is a Des Moines, Iowa rapper tied to the $357ENT crew who mixed and mastered this record himself.
NOAH sets the flood story in a modern frame, with guests including doseone, Fatboi Sharif and q no rap name.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (experimental/boom-bap). Released Oct 3, 2026 per Bandcamp (Apple lists Oct 4); self-released (P 2026 $357ENT). Featured in Bandcamp Daily's Best Hip-Hop October 2026 (https://daily.bandcamp.com/best-hip-hop/the-best-hip-hop-on-bandcamp-october-2026) and Hip Hop Golden Age's October round-up. No listener figures seen but a Bandcamp-scene artist, almost certainly well under 100k. No Spotify link verified. Bandcamp lists only Twitter, so IG empty.

songs.title: 2MUCH (feat. Kai Ca$h)
songs.verdict: A bouncy, UK-tinged drill cut where SWAVAY's sharp delivery is the selling point, and it was enough to land on Fantano's weekly best-tracks list.
songs.body:
SWAVAY is an independent rapper who has hopped between styles over several years of releases; Apple also credits Wizxrd as a main artist.
"2MUCH" is a drill-leaning single built to move to, with Kai Ca$h on the feature.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (drill). Released Nov 6, 2026 (Apple; HotNewHipHop agrees), P 2026 CRAZYMAN, independent. On theneedledrop's weekly track roundup for Nov 8 (https://theneedledrop.com/opinion/olivia-rodrigo-slayyyter-the-flaming-lips-justice-weekly-track-roundup-11826-xui1f9cmnb8/); also Remixd New Music Friday (https://remixdmagazine.com/new-music-friday-week-of-november-6/) and https://www.hotnewhiphop.com/1016278-2much-swavay-kai-cash. Spotify link is the single's release page (from Remixd embed). CHECK LISTENERS: older Apple artist ID, possibly a veteran; count unverified.

songs.title: The Gov't
songs.verdict: Barely a minute and a half of the loud, punchline-first West Memphis chaos that has made Fox BD one of the year's most talked-about new street rappers.
songs.body:
Fox BD is a West Memphis rapper (twin of YTB Fatt) named one of Stereogum's 40 best new artists of 2026, with a Lyrical Lemonade Lunch Break freestyle in September.
"The Gov't" is a short self-released single in his blown-out, darkly funny style.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (Southern street/scam-style). Released Oct 24, 2026 per Apple (P 2026 Fox BD). Stereogum best new artists: https://stereogum.com/2516509/the-40-best-new-artists-of-2026/lists/best-new-artists. Audiomack shows ~80k monthly listeners (https://audiomack.com/fox-bd). CHECK LISTENERS: Spotify likely over 100k given buzz, and Audiomack links a 10K Projects partner page (not a major). No review of this specific song found; verdict leans on Stereogum's description of his style. IG from his own Audiomack profile.

songs.title: Wishing Well
songs.verdict: A left turn from Australia's hyperpop scene: a gentle, country-tinged acoustic ballad given a glossy, deliberately artificial finish.
songs.body:
daine is an Australian hyperpop artist known for earlier singles like "PQC" and "I Used To Kill" with aldn.
"Wishing Well" led into the debut album In Endless Awe & Agony (Nov 6, 2026, Pack. Records).
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop lane. Premiered Oct 7, 2026 on Stereogum (https://stereogum.com/2513893/daine-wishing-well/music). CHECK LISTENERS: likely over 100k monthly; Pack. Records appears independent but unconfirmed. Alternative pick: the debut album itself (no link verified).

songs.title: White Flag
songs.verdict: The London duo trade their warped, bratty electroclash for hushed vocals over driving club drums on the lead single from a sprawling 19-track album.
songs.body:
Bassvictim is the London duo of singer Maria Manow and producer Ike Clateman, releasing on their own VOTB imprint.
"White Flag" fronts the album PEACE + WAR (announced for Nov 6, 2026), themed on vulnerability and volatility.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop/club-pop lane. Single out by Oct 25, 2026 (exact date not stated); album PEACE + WAR announced for Nov 6 via Mixmag (https://mixmag.net/read/new-music-on-our-radar-this-week-blackhaine-nabihah-iqbal-dngdngdng-news); see also https://stereogum.com/2510375/bassvictim-jagodki-blueberries/music. Independent imprint. CHECK LISTENERS: likely over 100k. Could swap to the album if it's out.

songs.title: 50 Bullets To The Heart
songs.verdict: Miami bass, Jersey club and grime collide with Timbaland-era R&B on a confrontational club record about heartbreak, grief and chronic pain.
songs.body:
Zora Jones is an Austrian producer and Fractal Fantasy co-founder; this is her first album since Ten Billion Angels, released on Bellyfat.
The 12-track record turns recovery into club music, and its live show debuted at MUTEK Montreal.
songs.scout_note: Left-field electronic lane. Released Oct 2, 2026 per DMY track-by-track (https://dmy.co/features/track-by-track-zora-jones-50-bullets-to-the-heart); also RA (https://ra.co/news/85435) and Mixmag. Independent label. Spotify link is the album opener 'Hurt'; SoundCloud link is the full album set. CHECK LISTENERS: possibly near or over 100k.

songs.title: Vestigio
songs.verdict: Cumbia and Afro-Peruvian rhythms pushed through jungle and UK hardcore on the Peruvian duo's first full-length in over seven years.
songs.body:
DNGDNGDNG (formerly Dengue Dengue Dengue) is a long-running Peruvian production duo; this is their first release under the new name.
Vestigio is a 10-track album on Club Romantico that RA framed as a deconstruction of polyrhythm and traditional Peruvian music.
songs.scout_note: Left-field electronic lane. Released Oct 22, 2026 per RA (https://ra.co/news/86137) and Mixmag. Indie label. Apple link converted from the Mixmag embed. Established act rather than a newcomer; CHECK LISTENERS, may be near 100k.

songs.title: Swans Tomorrow
songs.verdict: A 20-year-old bedroom auteur's lush, horn-swept EP that mixes jazzy chords and hip-hop drums under a voice critics keep comparing to Tim Buckley and King Krule.
songs.body:
Paulie Swan is an Edinburgh singer-songwriter who writes, plays, records and produces everything himself.
Swans Tomorrow is his second EP of 2026, with focus track "Edie" premiered by The Line of Best Fit.
songs.scout_note: Alt/indie lane. Released Nov 3, 2026. Sources: https://www.thelineofbestfit.com/tracks/paulie-swan-edie, https://www.theskinny.co.uk/music/interviews/spotlight-on-paulie-swan. Self-released, first single only came out Jan 2026, so very likely small. Focus track is 'Edie'; links are to the EP. IG from his official materials per scout.

songs.title: Your Love
songs.verdict: An LA duo with indie-rock roots leaning into pop hooks on a single that arrived days ahead of their debut album.
songs.body:
Swell Foop is Sophia Shen and Miranda Loyer, who started writing together in Berkeley and moved to LA; earlier EPs were Don't Spare Me (2024) and Dead Weight (2025).
"Your Love" comes from their debut album Most Likely (Nov 13, 2026, on broke).
songs.scout_note: Alt/indie lane. Single dated Nov 11, 2026 on Apple; album Nov 13. Source: https://artistrack.com/swell-foop-your-love-most-likely/. Small label (broke); some TikTok traction. CHECK LISTENERS: could be over 100k.

songs.title: teeth filed down
songs.verdict: Acoustic-guitar sapphic indie pop with an alt-rock edge, from a Brooklyn writer the press keeps filing next to Lucy Dacus and Clairo.
songs.body:
Nathalie Miller is a Brooklyn-based rising indie-pop singer-songwriter.
"teeth filed down" is one of the singles ahead of her debut album i'd like to think you saved me.
songs.scout_note: Alt/indie lane. Released Sep 18 per Melodic (year inferred 2026; https://www.melodicmag.com/news/new-music/nathalie-miller-explores-sapphic-love-in-new-single-teeth-filed-down/), right at the 60-day edge; follow-up 'you're in my bed' per Loud Women Oct 21 (https://loudwomen.org/2026/10/21/nathalie-miller-shares-dreamy-single-youre-in-my-bed/) could be swapped in. Spotify link from Melodic's embed. No label mentioned; size unknown. Press lists IG @nnaathali, not confirmed officially so left empty.

songs.title: Devotion
songs.verdict: Guitar-driven intensity wrapped around a delicate core, with the OK Computer-era Radiohead and Jeff Buckley echoes the band wears openly.
songs.body:
Tough Cookie is an East London band with Leeds roots who debuted in 2025 with the mixtape The Countryside Is Good For You.
Devotion (Gravity Records) takes its name from a Patti Smith book; focus track "Home Run" premiered on The Line of Best Fit.
songs.scout_note: Alt/indie lane. Released Oct 23, 2026 per Clash (https://clashmusic.com/news/indie-breakouts-tough-cookie-confirm-new-ep-devotion); track page https://www.thelineofbestfit.com/tracks/tough-cookie-home-run. Indie label. Spotify link is the EP. CHECK LISTENERS: possibly over 100k ('indie breakouts').

songs.title: Lover's Discourse
songs.verdict: Self-produced 70s quiet-storm R&B with jazz under the hood, organized around Roland Barthes' book on love, which is about as literary as R&B concepts get.
songs.body:
Dani Offline is a self-producing LA-based artist from Birmingham, Alabama, with a PhD in comparative literature and jazz study at Princeton.
The 12-track album draws its themes from Barthes' A Lover's Discourse; the funkier "ouch!" is the single.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. Released Sep 25, 2026 per Bandcamp; single 'ouch!' premiered on The Line of Best Fit (https://www.thelineofbestfit.com/tracks/dani-offline-ouch). Self-released; size unknown but likely small.

songs.title: NAJI
songs.verdict: An atmospheric debut of ambient soul and electronic textures, shaped by grief and mostly self-recorded in home studios.
songs.body:
Kareen Lomax is a singer-writer who has worked with Diplo, Leon Bridges and Syd; NAJI is her 13-track debut on Music Is Fun (Seeker Music).
The album, led by "OFFLINE", works through the loss of her adopted sister and father.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. Released Sep 18, 2026 (https://www.broadwayworld.com/article/Kareen-Lomax-Releases-Debut-Album-NAJI-20260918; Rated R&B new releases https://ratedrnb.com/2026/09/new-releases-josh-levi-kareen-lomax-jaymin/), right at the 60-day edge. Indie label, no major. CHECK LISTENERS: Diplo features may push her over 100k.

songs.title: Future
songs.verdict: Anxious, weary contemporary R&B that weighs the news cycle against the pressures of love, kids and money.
songs.body:
Joe Leone is an independent R&B singer; "Future" is a self-released single (P 2026 JBR Creative Group).
The song sets personal worries about relationships, family and finances against current events.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. Released Oct 2, 2026 per Apple; in Rated R&B's new releases (https://ratedrnb.com/2026/10/new-releases-lalah-hathaway-victoria-monet-nao/). Self-released. Size unknown; underground status not verified.

songs.title: Dancing Alone
songs.verdict: Mellow indie soul built from dreamy chimes, warm bass, delayed sax and smooth stacked harmonies.
songs.body:
Brotha Josh is Joshua Holt, a New Orleans-born, Birmingham-based multi-instrumentalist on The Record Machine whose project started as pandemic home demos.
"Dancing Alone" follows the 2022 EPs The Caller and The Operator.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. EARMILK post Sep 20, 2026 (https://earmilk.com/2026/09/20/brotha-joshs-dancing-alone-is-smooth-soulful-track-that-will-have-you-dancing-along-single/); exact release date not confirmed (likely Sep 19). Small indie label. EARMILK lists IG @brothajosh, unconfirmed so left empty.
